title: Preferred Partner and Top Rated Rates for Top-Performer Relief — Seller Performance Standing
content:
**Base rate.** The top-performer base rate is the Preferred Partner rate of 0.3 (30%) for a seller placed at Preferred Partner Level with no violation recorded in the last three whole calendar months, and the Top Rated rate of 0.2 (20%) for a seller placed at Top Rated Level with no violation recorded in that period. A seller with a violation recorded in that period takes neither of these rates.

The rate belongs to top-performer relief under Seller Performance Standing. Every violation type counts for the three-month test — listing policy, restricted product, intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity and review manipulation. Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a violation lies in the last three whole calendar months when fewer than three whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date.

## Schedule

| Level placed at | Violation recorded in the last three whole calendar months | Base rate |
|---|---|---|
| Preferred Partner Level | none | 0.3 |
| Top Rated Level | none | 0.2 |
| Preferred Partner Level or Top Rated Level | one or more | neither rate above |

## Boundary (hypothetical handling date 20 September)

| Level | Most recent violation recorded on | Whole months passed | Base rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Preferred Partner Level | 20 June | 3 | 0.3 |
| Preferred Partner Level | 21 June | 2 | neither rate above |
| Top Rated Level | 20 June | 3 | 0.2 |

**Worked figure.** 6 active points multiplied by 0.3 give 1.8; multiplied by 0.2 they give 1.2.
